thought.text: The desktop layout serves Vite entrypoints at `entrypoints/desktop.ts`. Let me verify those compile through the Vite dev server.

reasoning_content:
The `/desktop` route is returning the Vite entrypoint URL:
- `/assets/frontend/vite-dev/entrypoints/desktop.ts`
- `/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client`

In other words, the correct path is `entrypoints/desktop.ts`, not `desktop.ts`. That's why my earlier probe returned 404. So, let's fetch these through the Rails proxy to confirm that Vite's compilation is working.

action.command:
docker exec zammad-devcontainer-devcontainer-1 bash -c '
echo "=== @vite/client via proxy ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/client.js -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" --max-time 60 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/@vite/client"
head -c 150 /tmp/client.js; echo
echo "=== entrypoints/desktop.ts via proxy (triggers compile) ==="
curl -s -o /tmp/deskts.js -w "HTTP %{http_code} size %{size_download}\n" --max-time 300 "http://127.0.0.1:3000/assets/frontend/vite-dev/entrypoints/desktop.ts"
head -c 300 /tmp/deskts.js; echo
' 2>&1
